purpose: Identify actual nearby gameplay assets and their material references before choosing an identity-preserving appearance target.
position_source: First accepted street standard run, nearest logged sample to simulation second 40 (actual 40.3792).
operation: Read entity prefab and mesh resource names, material slot names and supported material-container map references. Capture the same location in private Workbench simulation. No scene, source material, game installation or asset modifications.
acceptance: At least one existing building/road material is linked to a visible gameplay asset with a verified source resource and map references. This identifies input data only; a game texture is not photorealistic ground truth, and a Workbench capture is not gameplay performance evidence.
failure: Preserve unresolved slots, inaccessible containers and failed logs. Stop after declared attempts if exact resource links cannot be read through supported APIs. Do not infer buffers from a screenshot or manufacture paired targets.
